glosses: To take a sudden and severe turn for the worse; to rapidly and catastrophically deteriorate.

examples.text: And the unvarying lesson of history is that all such balance of power peaces have crashed into new conflicts, as soon as the unstable equilibrium was disturbed, witness the Peace of Westphalia, the Congress of Vienna, and, in our own time, Versailles.
